reason: The quote lists "new-onset DM and weight loss" as two of three symptoms of glucagonoma. The claim specifies "hyperglycemia despite weight loss". While diabetes mellitus (DM) involves hyperglycemia, the quote does not use this specific term. More importantly, the quote enumerates symptoms, whereas the claim introduces a specific relationship ("despite") between hyperglycemia and weight loss that is not explicitly stated in the source text.
